description: Current status, estimated delivery and full scan history of one tracking number. A carrier that needs the recipient's postcode answers postcode_required until zipcode is passed.

carrier.description: Carrier id (see list_carriers). Omit to detect it from the number.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number or shipping container number, e.g. 1Z999AA10123456784 or MSKU7812341

zipcode.description: The recipient's postcode, for carriers that only show a parcel with it (PostNL; list_carriers names them under zipcode). Omit it unless you have it or a lookup answered postcode_required. For a parcel going abroad put the destination's two-letter country code first, e.g. BE-2000.

name: track_package
title: Track a package
